note: Append-only. A call goes up with the date it went public and gets checked on its check date. Misses stay up.

items.text: Raw Base Set Charizard is down 10% or more from its Sep 15 price. The reprint lands on the raw copies.
items.method: Checked Oct 16 against the TCGplayer market price for a raw Base Set Charizard, Sep 15 vs Oct 16.
items.latest: The 30th Celebration reprint hit shelves Sep 16.

items.text: Base Set Charizard PSA 10 is at or above its Sep 15 price. The graded population is closed, so the reprint can't enter it.
items.method: Checked Oct 16 against PSA 10 sold prices on 130point, Sep 15 vs Oct 16.
items.latest: The 30th Celebration reprint hit shelves Sep 16.

items.text: The 30th Celebration Booster Bundle's premium collapses once it ships Oct 2. The ETB holds its premium better.
items.method: Checked Oct 16: TCGplayer market price over retail for the Booster Bundle and the ETB, Sep 10 vs Oct 16.
